ResearchTabDef.label: Wildlife
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Develop organized hunting, stewardship, wildlife monitoring, and applied ecology. Natural animal behavior does not require research.

ResearchProjectDef.label: organized hunting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Formalize coordinated hunting techniques, advanced tracking, camouflage, scent masking, snares, and specialist positioning.

ResearchProjectDef.label: wildlife stewardship
ResearchProjectDef.description: Establish reserves, migration corridors, hunting regulations, population goals, and the formal role of Wildlife Steward.

ResearchProjectDef.label: wildlife expedition
ResearchProjectDef.description: Organize supplied wildlife parties that travel beyond the colony map to scout, track, hunt, capture, tag, or redirect regional wildlife.

ResearchProjectDef.label: wildlife telemetry
ResearchProjectDef.description: Use cameras, field optics, radio tracking collars, and automated surveys to monitor animals and regional migration.

ResearchProjectDef.label: applied ecology
ResearchProjectDef.description: Model habitat capacity, population pressure, disease risk, migration, and the likely consequences of ecological interventions.
